The '''Myrkr system''' contained the planet of [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] and the [[Myrkr (star)|cognominal star]].

==History==
During [[Thrawn campaign]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] returned to [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] after the [[Battle of Sluis Van]] in retaliation for the [[Rescue on Myrkr]]. He guessed the presence of the ''[[Wild Karrde]]'' in the system and tried to intercept it with the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] [[Constrainer/Legends|''Constrainer'']] but the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] were able to escape thanks to [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] who felt the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack.<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>
